lines.text: Previously. Tyr the Frost Titan cracked the golden wall over Saint Lumen.
I opened the door. Akuro killed the Titan, and then turned on the city.
lines.tts: I opened the door. Ah-koo-roh killed the Titan, and then turned on the city.

lines.text: Nemu stood in front of me and spent her eighth life. I came back.
lines.tts: Neh-moo stood in front of me and spent her eighth life. I came back.

lines.text: And the Saint decided that to mend his wall, he would take every Brand in the city.
Light of the city. Come home to the wall.
Great Sanctum. Close.
Mama? Mama, I feel cold.
My fire. Takuto, my fire is shrinking. It has never been this small.
lines.tts: My fire. Tah-koo-toh, my fire is shrinking. It has never been this small.

lines.text: My threads are thin. Like hair. I can barely hold them.
Everything is spinning. Is the room spinning? Or is it me?
Nemu, sit.
lines.tts: Neh-moo, sit.

lines.text: I am sitting. I think. It is hard to tell.
It is the Great Sanctum. It is drinking every Brand under the dome. All of them. At once.
How long?
By sunset, every Brand in Saint Lumen is in the wall. Hunters. Children. Us.
And the axe?
It is pulling at me too, boy. Gently. Like a thief who thinks the house is asleep. I do not like it.
Akuro does not like it.
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh does not like it.

lines.text: Then we have something in common with him. That is a first.
Darlings. My Encore is a candle. Gideon's chains are getting lazy. Vesper's wind is a breeze. We have perhaps eight hours.
Then we use them. Haruki. Where is the heart of the Sanctum?
lines.tts: Then we use them. Hah-roo-kee. Where is the heart of the Sanctum?

lines.text: Under the cathedral. The crystal chamber, where the forty sleep. Lucien stands at the altar. He is the wall. As long as he wills it, it holds.
Then the boy strikes the altar.
He cracked the Sanctum once. A hairline. Lucien was surprised. He will not be surprised again. His will is stronger than the barrier.
Then I need him to stop willing it.
For three seconds.
...Frozen Hour.
If I freeze the Saint himself, his will stops with him. Three seconds of a wall with nobody holding it.
You have to touch him to freeze him. Inside his own Sanctum. With Sable beside him.
I know. I have touched him a thousand times. He always let me.
The Order has sealed every gate. Two hundred knights. They will not let a Branded near the cathedral.
Then Gideon and I will give them a show at the cathedral doors. Encore, and every iron hinge in the building.
I have always wanted to make a cathedral door fight a knight.
I take the north gate. The knights there would like to keep the wounded out of the city. They are about to change their minds.
And I go with you. One sword. A frog crutch. Ha. Do not argue, Valentine.
I was not going to argue. I was going to cry.
Nemu and me. The Rite Hall. The people in the golden chairs. We carry them out before the wall eats them.
lines.tts: Neh-moo and me. The Rite Hall. The people in the golden chairs. We carry them out before the wall eats them.

lines.text: I can carry people. Slowly. On my tail.
And I tie the way open. For you two. Into the crystal chamber, and back out.
Rin. If the thread snaps...
Then Kaito's scarf still holds. You have it on your wrist.
Takuto. Last lesson. Always the first move.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Last lesson. Always the first move.

lines.text: Not this time. This time Haruki moves first.
lines.tts: Not this time. This time Hah-roo-kee moves first.

lines.text: ...Ha. Good. Now you are a teacher.
Halt! By order of the Saint, no Branded may enter!
Shields up! Shields up!
Ladies and gentlemen of the Gilded Order! Tonight, for one performance only!
Encore!
Cogwheel Core! Doors! Hinges! Candlesticks! Everyone, up!
The doors! The doors are fighting us!
Why are we dancing? Why can't I stop dancing?
Go, boy! The stairs behind the altar! Go!
Gideon. Valentine. Thank you.
Thank us at the cast party, darling. GO!
Executioner! The Guild has no authority in the holy city!
Stand down!
The Guild has no authority. I have a great deal of wind. White Gale.
Open the gate, and let the wounded in. Or fly.
Behind us. Ten knights. I can hold five. With the crutch, maybe four.
Then I will hold the other six, Valen.
Kurozane!
I said after. This is after. If the Saint drinks your Brand, there is nothing left for me to kill.
Ha! That is the most romantic thing anyone has ever said to me.
Do not make it strange, Valen. Fang Draw.
The gate is open! Bring the wounded through! Move!
Ha! Kurozane, behind you. Not that one. The OTHER one.
Stop helping, Valen. You are bouncing.
Efficiently! Gideon says I bounce efficiently!
Takuto. The cat. Did you ever give it a name?
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. The cat. Did you ever give it a name?

lines.text: Coffee.
You named the cat Coffee.
It drank coffee milk. It made sense.
Ha. I called it Mister Tuesday. Because I met it on a Tuesday.
That is worse.
It is much worse. I am glad you never knew.
If I do not come back up these stairs...
You are coming back up.
If I do not, tell my mother I was trying to help people. Even when I was wrong. Especially then.
Tell her yourself. That is the plan. Three seconds, then home for dinner.
...Three seconds. Then dinner.
Who... who is there? I cannot feel my hands.
It is okay! We are Hunters! Rank F! Well, rank F with a lot of experience! We are getting you out!
Arms around my neck. Hold the tail if you cannot hold me. It is a very strong tail.
Your head is on fire.
It is so warm. Thank you. Thank you.
Everybody says that! It is my head! It is always on fire! You are welcome!
Wick. There are sixty chairs. We have carried eleven.
Then we carry forty-nine more. Rank F does not stop. Rank F has nothing to lose.
...You are very brave today.
I am terrified, Nemu. That is my brave face. Keep carrying.
lines.tts: I am terrified, Neh-moo. That is my brave face. Keep carrying.

lines.text: Haruki. You came home.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee. You came home.

lines.text: This was never home, Lucien. It was a waiting room.
Takuto. Look around you. Forty people, sleeping. A hundred thousand, alive. Do you know what holds the sky shut over this city?
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Look around you. Forty people, sleeping. A hundred thousand, alive. Do you know what holds the sky shut over this city?

lines.text: Them.
Them. And me. For twelve years I have chosen who pays. Do you think that was easy?
I think you liked choosing.
You do not get to choose who pays. Nobody does. Break the wall. Let them choose for themselves.
And when the Rift opens? When the sky eats this city the way it ate my village?
Then we close it. All of us. Without anyone in a chair.
Oh, I love him. Lucien, isn't he wonderful? He believes it.
Sable. You brought me here.
And you came all the way down the stairs. Like a good key. Now, be a dear. Strike the wall.
He wants you to break it. Why does he want you to break it?
Ask the Saint what the wall is holding shut, thread girl. Ask him what is on the other side of the oldest scar in the sky.
...Sable. You said it was the Rift. Only the Rift.
It is a Rift, Lucien. To the place I came from. I have been knocking on it for three hundred years. You have been holding the door shut. I am so grateful for your patience.
There it is, boy. That is what I fought in the sky. That is what is behind the door. Do not let him through.
Then I will open it the rude way.
Red Thread! Hold him! Hold him still!
Got you. Thin threads, but a lot of them.
Clever girl. Your brother was clever too. Before.
...Before what?
Before he went into my Rift after a little monster I let out for him. He was very brave about it.
Then I will hold you twice as hard.
Sanctum. Close.
Break.
Nothing breaks it. NOTHING.
Boy. Let me. Just this once more. I can break it. You know I can.
No. This time it is me. Only me.
...Then do not miss.
Haruki.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: I know. Rin, the gap. Tie it open.
One gap. Two seconds. Go!
Haruki, don't!
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee, don't!

lines.text: You caught me once. Let me catch you.
Frozen Hour.
Three.
Two.
One. Takuto!
lines.tts: One. Tah-koo-toh!

lines.text: RUINBREAKER!
The light. It is going back. Out of the walls. Into people.
The beds. The crystal beds are cracking open.
...It broke. Twelve years. And it broke.
It was always going to, Lucien. Everything breaks. That is why you need people, not walls.
Haruki. When you fell. I did catch you. That part was real.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee. When you fell. I did catch you. That part was real.

lines.text: I know. That is why it hurt so much.
Bravo. Bravo! Oh, Ruinbreaker. You opened my door at last.
The oldest scar in the sky is open. And it goes to so many places.
Goodbye for now, Takuto. Give my regards to the cat.
lines.tts: Goodbye for now, Tah-koo-toh. Give my regards to the cat.

lines.text: SABLE!
Takuto. Look at the crack. Look what is on the other side.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Look at the crack. Look what is on the other side.

lines.text: That is... that is the crossing. In Nerima. That is our crossing.
lines.tts: That is... that is the crossing. In Neh-ree-mah. That is our crossing.

lines.text: We got them out. All of them. Every chair. I... what is that? Is that... is that Japan?
It is closing. Slowly. A minute. Maybe two.
Osaka is down there. Somewhere. Four tables. My mom.
lines.tts: Oh-sah-kah is down there. Somewhere. Four tables. My mom.

lines.text: You should go, Wick.
...Three years, I wanted this. Every single night. Corn soup. Vending machines. My mom yelling at me to flip the pancakes.
And now it is right there. And all I can think about is that nobody here can make okonomiyaki but me.
That is true. We would starve.
I have friends here, Nemu. That is the first time in three years I could say that. I am not leaving my first friends to go look for a pancake.
lines.tts: I have friends here, Neh-moo. That is the first time in three years I could say that. I am not leaving my first friends to go look for a pancake.

lines.text: Takuto. You came here for me. I am here. The road home is right there.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. You came here for me. I am here. The road home is right there.

lines.text: What about you?
Forty people in crystal are waking up and do not know where they are. I put some of them in those beds. I am staying until they are home.
...Then I am staying too.
Takuto. Your mother.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Your mother.

lines.text: My mother has your mother. They put posters on poles together. They will be fine for a little while longer.
Sable is loose. The scar is open. And there is a cat at the crossing who needs somebody to feed it coffee milk.
I am not going home to feed the cat while the man who brought me here walks around. I am going to find him. And break him.
...You are staying.
I still have your brother's scarf on my wrist. I have to give it back with me attached.
Idiot.
You will go back someday. When you are done breaking things here.
Someday.
Takuto. If you ever get back there. Buy two corn soups from a machine. Drink one for me.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. If you ever get back there. Buy two corn soups from a machine. Drink one for me.

lines.text: We will get back. Both of us. And I will buy three.
Three? Who is the third one for?
Coffee.
...The cat. You are buying corn soup for the cat. That is a terrible thing to give a cat.
Goodbye, Nerima. Not yet.
lines.tts: Goodbye, Neh-ree-mah. Not yet.

lines.text: My mark! My mark came back!
Mama, I am warm again. I am warm!
Mira. Mira, it is me. Haruki.
lines.tts: Mira. Mira, it is me. Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: Haruki? Is this... is this Osaka?
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee? Is this... is this Oh-sah-kah?

lines.text: ...No. Not yet. But I am going to take you there. I promise. A real promise this time.
Lucien Aurel. By the authority of the Hunters' Guild, you are under arrest. I have a letter. I wrote it myself.
...Takuto. The scar will open again. Without a wall, the sky will come for this city.
lines.tts: ...Tah-koo-toh. The scar will open again. Without a wall, the sky will come for this city.

lines.text: Then we will be on the wall. Standing. Not sitting in chairs.
...I hope you are right. For their sake. I truly do.
Valen. The Saint is broken. The suit is gone. We are both still standing.
So, our duel?
...Another day. I find I am enjoying waiting for it.
Patience is a very scary bear, Kurozane.
What?
Ha ha ha! I will tell you the joke someday. You will hate it.
Welcome back, Hunters! All nine of you! Ten, counting Tofu! Eleven, counting the hat!
The hat is not a member.
The hat has been through a LOT, Gideon.
Tofu has been begging to read Takuto again. He thinks he can finally do it.
lines.tts: Tofu has been begging to read Tah-koo-toh again. He thinks he can finally do it.

lines.text: Ruinbreaker. Rank...
Error. With a little crown. He drew the crown himself.
Still an error.
The best kind, darling. The kind that breaks the rules.
Also, the Guild has promoted you. All of you. Rank F to rank C!
RANK C! Mom! I am rank C! I skipped two ranks!
Does rank C get more bread?
Rank C gets slightly more bread.
Then it is worth it.
One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven. Eight. Nine. Ten.
You are counting.
Ten. Everyone is here. And I am going to count it every night, out loud, until you are all sick of it.
Takuto. The scarf.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. The scarf.

lines.text: With me attached. Like I said.
...Keep it.
You said it stays the way he wore it.
He would have liked it on you. Do not make a thing of it.
Error. A word.
Vesper.
The Guild asked me for a report on you. I wrote one page. It is very boring. Nothing about it is red.
Thank you.
Keep it boring. I would like to read more boring reports about you for a very long time.
You know, boy. Three hundred years in an axe, and these are the loudest people I have ever met.
You like them.
...Ask me again in another three hundred years.
Ashford rebuilt the forge. Gideon made the new door fight the old one, just to see who would win.
In Marrowmere, the little girl who saw the sad head got a job at the Guild. She is the youngest cousin.
Fort Cinder put thirty-one names on a stone. Giant names. Commander Hale made them up himself.
The Plume Ogres sent a feather to every village in the Greatwood. Nobody has been raided since.
There are forty graves at the pass shrine. Kurozane cleans them every morning. He says it is for practice.
And in Saint Lumen, forty people who slept in crystal are learning how to buy bread. Haruki is teaching them.
lines.tts: And in Saint Lumen, forty people who slept in crystal are learning how to buy bread. Hah-roo-kee is teaching them.

lines.text: This is where I first died in front of you.
You say it like it is a nice memory.
It is. It is where I met you. The dying part was only a little bit of it.
Do you remember what the axe asked you? Here. That night.
What is it you want to break.
And? What do you want to break? Now?
...Sable. Someday. The scar in the sky. The idea that somebody has to sit in a chair so everybody else can be safe.
But today? Nothing. Not today.
Good. Today is for sleeping.
Hello, kitty. Waiting for someone?
He is not coming tonight. But I am sure he will. Everyone always comes.
